shots.line: Welcome to Helsinki under the northern lights. There are 68 startups on this map, and 8 of them are hiring.
Over at Töölönlahdenkatu 2, Verda runs data centres and GPU hardware for training AI models, backed by a 189 million dollar Series B.
Nearby on Lapinlahdenkatu 16, Saidot builds an AI governance platform to help teams track risks and policies.
Down on Pursimiehenkatu 29, Aiforia Technologies uses AI to analyze medical images, mainly for pathology.
And out at Henry Fordin katu 6, ReOrbit builds satellites and software for national security.
From business software to health and space, take a look around the city and explore at your own pace.
